answer_text: BGP Hold Time is negotiated between peers, and the final value used is the lower Hold Time from either side. With your 10/30 timers, make sure the Nexus 9k and the Cato Socket agree on a Hold Time of 30 seconds (the example in our KB shows both sides converge on 30 while keeping the keep-alive at 10). If needed, adjust the Nexus to Hold Time 30 so both ends use 30; keep-alive can remain at 10. If flapping persists, you can enable BFD for BGP neighbors to speed up failure detection.
